KHADLAJ ISLAND SUN 100 ML EXTRAIT DE PARFUM

Escape into a radiant world of tropical warmth with ISLAND SUN by Khadlaj Perfumes, a vibrant Extrait de Parfum inspired by sun-soaked shores, exotic fruits, and effortless elegance. Fresh, juicy, and beautifully sensual, this fragrance captures the feeling of an endless summer in every spray.

Top Notes – Mango, Coconut, Lime, Lemon
The fragrance opens with a mouthwatering burst of ripe mango and creamy coconut, brightened by the sparkling freshness of lime and lemon. This lively tropical introduction is refreshing, uplifting, and instantly captivating.

Heart Notes – Pink Pepper, Jasmine, Orange Blossom
At the heart, delicate jasmine and luminous orange blossom unfold with elegant floral richness, while pink pepper adds a subtle spicy sparkle that gives the composition a modern and sophisticated character.

Base Notes – Musk, Tonka Bean, Precious Woods
As the fragrance settles, smooth musk blends with the warm sweetness of tonka bean and refined precious woods, creating a sensual and comforting trail with lasting depth.

A Tropical Escape in Every Spray:
ISLAND SUN is crafted for those who love bright, exotic fragrances with an elegant and luxurious finish. Its blend of juicy tropical fruits, radiant florals, and warm woody notes makes it a perfect companion for sunny days, holidays, special occasions, or whenever you want to carry the spirit of summer with you.

Experience the Glow of ISLAND SUN:
Fresh yet sensual, playful yet sophisticated, KHADLAJ ISLAND SUN leaves behind an irresistible signature that evokes golden sunlight, tropical breezes, and unforgettable moments.

KHADLAJ MUSE 100 ML EAU DE PARFUM

Discover the refined elegance of MUSE by Khadlaj Perfumes, a sophisticated Eau de Parfum that blends luminous florals, creamy accords, and warm gourmand notes into an irresistibly smooth composition. Elegant, comforting, and captivating, MUSE is crafted for those who appreciate a fragrance with graceful depth and lasting charm.

Top Notes – Orange Blossom, Bergamot, Almond
The fragrance opens with the radiant freshness of bergamot and delicate orange blossom, beautifully complemented by the soft, nutty richness of almond. This inviting introduction creates a bright yet creamy first impression.

Heart Notes – Orris, Jasmine, Cream Accord
At the heart, elegant orris and jasmine unfold into a luxurious floral bouquet, enriched by a smooth cream accord. The result is a velvety and sophisticated character that gives the fragrance its distinctive softness.

Base Notes – Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber, White Musk
The composition settles into a warm and sensual base of creamy vanilla and tonka bean, wrapped in glowing amber and clean white musk. This comforting foundation leaves behind a smooth, elegant, and long-lasting trail.

Elegance in Every Spray:
MUSE is a beautifully balanced fragrance where fresh citrus, delicate florals, creamy nuances, and warm sweetness come together in perfect harmony. Its refined character makes it ideal for everyday elegance as well as special occasions.

Embrace Your Inspiration:
Soft, sophisticated, and effortlessly alluring, KHADLAJ MUSE is more than a fragrance it is an expression of confidence, elegance, and timeless beauty.
